plan.direction: daily volatility-compression breakout with close-channel exit; long-only independent BTC/ETH spot sleeves
plan.economic_hypothesis: Volatility clusters and compression can precede expansion; a close-only breakout after a recent low-volatility regime may reduce false entries. This is a testable hypothesis, not an asserted crypto premium.

literature_context.citation: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), Time series momentum, Journal of Financial Economics 104(2), 228-250
literature_context.scope_note: Motivates trend-continuation as a broad asset-class hypothesis; does not validate this spot strategy.

literature_context.citation: Shen, Urquhart & Wang (2022), Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum, Financial Review 57, 319-344
literature_context.scope_note: Finds specific intraday volume-clock predictability; used only as motivation to test regime-conditioned continuation, not replicated here.
Source format reference; the backtest uses locally normalized Binance spot klines with recorded file hashes.

data.history_note: This 2025-09-19..2026-09-14 interval is repeatedly reused development/evaluation history, not an untouched final holdout.

capital_and_allocation.meaning: 50/50 initial cash allocation into independent BTC and ETH sleeves; no normalization, cross-sleeve transfer, leverage or rebalancing between sleeves. Each sleeve may move between its own spot coin and USDT.
capital_and_allocation.positioning: Long-only spot; no funding or borrow.

signal_definition.decision: At daily decision index i, use only the fully closed daily bar i-1; its availability is 00:00 UTC and the trade reference is the 00:01 UTC 1-minute open of day i.
signal_definition.volatility: For each completed daily close j, sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the last 10 completed close-to-close log returns, ending at close j.
signal_definition.compression: At close j, compare that 10-day volatility with the NumPy linear/type-7 quantile of the preceding 180 daily volatility observations (strictly through j-1); compressed if current volatility is at or below the configured percentile.
signal_definition.compression_recency: An entry breakout qualifies if at least one of the last 3 completed daily closes (j-2..j) met the compression condition; all referenced values are already available at decision time.
signal_definition.entry: If flat, close[j] is strictly greater than the maximum of exactly the configured N immediately preceding completed daily closes; the tested close is excluded from the channel. Require recent compression.
signal_definition.exit: If long, close[j] is strictly less than the minimum of exactly the configured M immediately preceding completed daily closes; the tested close is excluded. Exit has precedence over re-entry on the same decision.
signal_definition.state: Single long/cash state per asset sleeve, carried continuously across adjacent 30-day reporting folds; no fold reset or pre-OOS trades.
signal_definition.execution: Marketable limit IOC estimate at the next day 00:01 UTC minute open; not an exchange fill guarantee. Terminal holdings liquidated at 2026-09-14 00:01 UTC open with costs.

plan.sensitivity_protocol: Full 3x3x3 grid frozen before outcomes; local neighbors differ by at most one grid step on every axis. Report every cell and 1x/2x/3x outcomes; no OOS parameter selection.

cost_model.impact: 0.5 * sample_std(last 20 complete daily log returns) * sqrt(order budget / mean quote ADV over prior 20 complete UTC daily bars)
cost_model.simultaneously_scale: fees, half-spread estimate, slippage estimate, square-root impact and adverse tick rounding
cost_model.fees_and_spread: Fee is paid once per simulated side; estimated half-spread is applied once per side and not charged a second time.
cost_model.capacity_and_rounding: Enforce frozen PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL, and prior-5-closed-minute VWAP proxy for PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE; quantity is floored to LOT_SIZE and price rounded adversely to tick.
cost_model.data_limitations: No historical L2 or queue position; spread, slippage, square-root impact and immediate full IOC execution are explicit estimates.

predeclared_failure_criteria.definition: A cell is passed only if every criterion is true; otherwise rejected after a complete historical backtest. These are screening criteria, not proof of live profitability.

benchmarks.note: Previously registered and computed on the same 360-day window, 1000 USDT per BTC/ETH sleeve and 1x/2x/3x cost model; read-only comparator.

preexisting_trial_context.initial_16_status: Repository automation history reports all initial 16 items already have real backtest evidence; no eligible missing-result retry was found in this round.
preexisting_trial_context.selection_bias: Thousands of related BTC/ETH configurations and the same OOS history have already been examined; all findings are exploratory and multiple-testing biased.

evaluation_recovery.first_start: failed before data loading or strategy calculation
evaluation_recovery.exception: KeyError: BTCUSDT while indexing the frozen exchange filter snapshot; its keys are BTC and ETH
evaluation_recovery.fix: Mapped base-asset keys BTC/ETH to Binance symbols BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT. Re-ran the same 27 already-reserved specs; no partial trades or report from the failed attempt.
